subject: general
question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

IC-LF-NP

KE-NH-PR
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a48553e14e7560db7a14de8a4826ac702bbff6e9883a46b3b4d5edb549a7e9f9.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster triad follows the pattern +3, +3 and +2, +10.

IC-LF-NP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d33640194a45a22e15bde1e8ddc2207baaf064260942feb018f5ce935adc6793.png] 

KE-NH-PR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f31ecb920f2ae6546020c5777a4e2bb33bde024ece98202fbfe868c2108917b.png] 

Let's check each option:

1. MG-PJ-RT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76f8f0c3d2e19f533bf79c57e15b721e8f6c13b929a1358ed85fe1bd7f981bd1.png] 

This letter-cluster triad follows the pattern +3, +3 and +2, +10.

2. MG-PJ-RU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/536f7252c4caecb762b7b2dd3593659bf381fc64c0565e577d3f7493e5c6dee6.png] 

This letter-cluster triad does not follow the pattern +3, +3 and +2, +10.

3. NG-PI-RU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc65089a9649b074cf89f70e4b3b89c0442345f67e4d54439ecfcebecdb3c387.png] 

This letter-cluster triad does not follow the pattern +3, +3 and +2, +10.

4. NG-PJ-RU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/239a21f751b846d44f407f59d575eb151e71c7b57e35b7648ee4f2d03205f97a.png] 

This letter-cluster triad does not follow the pattern +3, +3 and +2, +10.

Thus, MG-PJ-RT follows the same pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
